text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the way back, as we passed by a park—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey hey, Trainer! Or 'Train-ey' for short!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Wanna go swinging with some quick swings?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoever bites their tongue first while 
singing on the swings loses!
choice_data_list: What kind of game is that...?

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Young Girl
text_block_list.text: S-S-S-Save meeeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? What is that, Armageddon or 
something!?

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Young Girl
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? N-No, it's not on that big of a 
scale.

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Young Girl
text_block_list.text:
I'm in a real pinch here! I need help! 
Look, right over there...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A young girl around ten years old suddenly 
ran up to me. Looking visibly flustered, 
she pointed across the street, so I looked 
over to see...

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man A
text_block_list.text: Damn it, where'd they go...?!

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man B
text_block_list.text:
She definitely ran off this way... Hey, 
check inside the playground equipment!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa, look at those guys. 
They're practically screaming 'Suspicious 
Guy A' and 'Suspicious Guy B.'

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, little lady. Don't tell me... 
someone's chasin' ya?

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Young Girl
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Actually, that's right...! So um, 
please don't be surprised, but...

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Young Girl
text_block_list.text:
I am the princess of a certain kingdom... 
and an assassin is after my life!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Whaaaaat the heeeeellll!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Then are you... are you the true, rightful 
heir to the lost "Platinum Realm"?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I heard the king met an untimely death in 
a coup 12 years ago, and his 21 daughters 
were scattered to the winds, but...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Princess... thank goodness... thank 
goodness you are safe!! I am overjoyed to 
see you...!!

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Young Girl
text_block_list.text: Uh, umm...

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man A
text_block_list.text:
No luck, she's nowhere to be found... Good 
grief, she's a handful every single time.

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man B
text_block_list.text:
Miladyyy! Your study session was supposed 
to start ages agooo!! Your father is going 
to scold you againnn!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It seems this girl is being "pursued" 
for an entirely different reason, however.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Now is the time for this 'Golden Knight' 
to fulfill her duty! Princess, I shall 
protect you from these scoundrels!"

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Young Girl
text_block_list.text:
...Well said, my knight! From this moment 
on, you are my shield—work to your heart's 
content!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I am deeply honored!! To lay down my 
life for the Princess is my greatest 
desire!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright, my right-hand man... wait, that's 
giving you too much credit. My trainer, 
roughly equivalent to the mole on my right 
cheek!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
We must devise a plan to protect the 
Princess! What shall we do? What, oh what 
shall we do!?
choice_data_list: It's better for the kid to be found.
It's for their own good to be found.

"The best place to hide a tree is in a 
forest"...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
We must devise a plan to protect the 
Princess! What shall we do? What, oh what 
shall we do!?
choice_data_list: It's better for the kid to be found.
It's for their own good to be found.

"The best place to hide a tree is in a 
forest"...!

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Young Girl
text_block_list.text:
Eep... No way! If they find me, I'll have 
to study by myself again... Ah, I-I 
mean...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Gah!! Thaaat's why you'll never be 
anything more than a mole, got it?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Princess, let us leave this mole alone 
until a hair sprouts from it.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Now, more importantly, climb onto my back! 
I shall demonstrate the true essence of 
the 'Golden Knight' right here!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
ORA ORA ORA ORAAAH!! Get outta the way 
unless you wanna get hurt!!

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Men
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa!? Wh-What's going on!? ...Wait, 
milady! P-Please wait up!

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Young Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Big si... I mean, Knight, you're 
super fast!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Gahahahaha!! I am the lethal weapon of El 
Dorado, the "Golden Knight" herself!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And so, I ended up joining the men in 
chasing after Gold Ship and the girl on 
her back."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Whaaat!? To think there was a method 
like that...! As expected of my "Master 
Tactician"...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
All right, no time to waste! Princess, 
right this way!

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Young Girl
text_block_list.text: Eh, what?

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Young Girl
text_block_list.text:
Waah, so cool, so cool...!! So this is the 
racetrack... It's my first time here~!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Woohoo! With this many people around, 
nobody's gonna notice a thing!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"You actually say something good once in a 
while! I'm upgrading you from a mole to an 
eyelash!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After enjoying the race together for a 
while, we politely escorted the young girl 
back home.
